text: Rebuild web_dist: served bundle is stale, missing all of this session's web fixes

Done in the web_dist rebuild commit. New hashed assets (index-VUEWjBx0.js /
index-0RqL0Bzr.css) now include the T-42/T-43/T-47 web changes and the
currency-dialog fix; server webapp+landing tests green against the new bundle.
Workflow reminder for future sessions: web/src changes are NOT live on the served
site until `cd web && npm run build` re-emits into server/src/shoppinglist_server/
web_dist/ and the result is committed — index.html must always be revalidated
(max-age=0) so browsers pick up the new hashes, which routes/webapp.py already does.
